correctness.rationale: For Lipschitz piecewise-affine McKean drift and fixed D>0, the process reset at b+ξ/√r has regenerative law X_Exp(r); exact identity μ−v_r=[Ef(X_Exp(r))+I0−w]/r. Brownian displacement at independent exponential time is Laplace with scale sqrt(D/r); the exact positive-part identity E(ξ+Y)_+−ξ_+=sqrt(D)/2 exp(−|ξ|/sqrt(D)). Globally Lipschitz SDE drift changes Ef by O_K(r^-1) and the remote kink has exponentially small contribution; slope jump Δ_b therefore produces Δ_b sqrt(D)/(2r^(3/2)) exp(−|ξ|/sqrt(D))+O_K(r^-2). The averaged map w→μ/γ is a contraction for r>L+γ^-1, giving unique globally attracting equilibrium and same coefficient/γ. Independently integrated the Laplace hinge identity; finite-volume evidence is corroboration, not infinite proof.
